The '''''Keelkana''-class attack submersible''' was a type of [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] produced by [[Mon Calamari Subworks/Legends|Mon Calamari Subworks]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Each submersible was unique, though all had a design that somewhat resembled a [[manta ray]].<ref name="SoR" />
